newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ATHLETICS-SJOBERG PULLS OUT OF INDOOR CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-SJOBERG PULLS OUT OF INDOOR CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Sweden's former world record high jump champion Patrik Sjoberg has decided not to take part in the world indoor championships in Paris this weekend, Swedish newspapers said on Tuesday.

Sjoberg, 32, pulled out of the Grand Prix gala in Birmingham, England, last month after he was hit with a glass during a celebrities party at a trendy Stockholm night club and needed nine stitches in his face.
Tabloid newspaper Aftonbladet said Sjoberg was now injury free but has had problems during the winter with cramp in his calves and did not feel adequately prepared to compete in Paris.
Sjoberg was planning to spend a few weeks in Marbella, Spain to prepare himself for his opening appearance of the the outdoor season in Hengelo in the Netherlands on May 31, the newspaper said.
